decision_rationale: Oracle floor passed (mean Oracle EM = 0.9905 >= 0.85). Strongest deterministic baseline (exhaustive lawful search over all 584 candidates) achieves near-ceiling functional EM (mean = 0.9904 >= 0.95, and >= 0.95 across every tested bundle seed). Confirms that exact-depth-3 compositions of the current 8-primitive registry are within the tractable reach of lawful deterministic search, empirically supporting ADR-0162's Bounded-Resource Corollary restricted to depth <= 3.
